prompt: Among active male soccer players with over 50 international goals, who has the highest goals-per-match ratio?
answer: **Erling Haaland of Norway** has the highest goals-per-match ratio among active male players with more than 50 international goals—approximately **1.1 goals per game** (about 65 goals in 57–59 appearances, depending on the statistical source).
